title: Amazon Tall Tower Observatory
visualBrief: Square 3 m research lattice with closed angle-section chords and X braces, visible bolt heads, red/white bands, 1500 grated treads and landings, safety rails, cable trays, 321 m top platform, 331 m lightning rod, six guy levels, external HighStep rails and a detailed stationary RoLi instrument carriage. Shared painted steel, stainless steel and concrete; repeated sections are GPU instances.

assembly.method: Reusable named mesh parts with glTF node transforms; shared materials, no duplicated bitmap library.

nativeAxes.front: Native (-X,+Z) shaft corner carries the lift. At heading 23 degrees, that corner faces published azimuth 202 degrees; +Y is up.
nativeAxes.origin: Main mapped tower center; Y0 standard viewer PMTiles working datum.

scaleBasis: MPI publishes a 3×3 m cross section, 325 m frame, 331 m tip and 1500 steps. The 2025 field report/drawing fixes the 321 m platform; the 2026 RoLi paper fixes the 202-degree lift corner, rail spacing and six guy heights. Bolted angles, stairs, top platform and instruments follow inspected operator photographs. Flange dimensions, paint-band boundaries, individual tread distribution and guy anchor radii are proportional reconstruction requiring further confirmation.

geographicProposal.evidence: Two inspected pictures support the slender red/white square lattice shaft, top platform/outriggers and paired guy cables. Retained tower node and heading23 degrees provide approximate location/facing. Standard viewer PMTiles working datum 134.05314223787755m supplies ground. Browser derivatives place the main slab at modelY.35 and each approximate guy block/cable endpoint on the same sampled grid. The preserved detailed master remains an archival instanced geometry source; the four browser derivatives supply terrain-fitted display. This round covers the main tall tower, not separate companion towers or the laboratory compound.
geographicProposal.limitations: Guy radii/topology and exact compound location remain approximate. Separate companion towers/laboratory are outside this main-tower asset.

geometrySource: Original deterministic geometry informed by cited dimensions, measured plans and photographs. No downloaded mesh or photographic texture is embedded.
sourceLicense: Original geometry under repository license. Map-derived outline information is attributed to OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Reference publications retain their own rights.
materialMethod: Shared material graphs with metric repeat UV0 and original vertex tints; GLB PBR fallback remains self-contained. No per-model texture duplication.
limitations: Approximate main tall-tower exterior and PMTiles fit from two inspected pictures; no bespoke survey or full compound claim.
Original detailed master and repeated mesh instances preserved. Independent browser tiers reduce brace/stair/instrument detail by view distance.

Guy radii75/150/225m and paired topology are interpreted retained controls; new browser blocks and cable endpoints meet one coarse PMTiles field. Exact anchors, sag, restoration details and equipment inventory are approximate.
Three shared painted-metal/stainless/concrete graphs; zero embedded images. Forest and natural ground remain host content.
